description: Record something the user did or observed: watered, fertilized, transplanted, pruned, pest sighting, treatment, frost damage, or a note. Attach it to a plant's active planting via `plant`, to a bed via `bed`, or garden-wide with neither. If both plant and bed are given, the event attaches to the plant's planting.

garden.description: Garden name; defaults to the user's first garden.

plant.description: Plant name — targets its most recent active planting.

plantingId.description: Exact planting id (from query_plantings) — overrides plant.

name: log_event
title: Log a garden event
